notes.title: Book 2 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello! Good progress being made. I now have a separate render rig. This helps with output significantly, it also makes my power company happy. Book 2 steam page will be out this month, start banking those wish lists. A December release is planned. Book 2 will release into EA with chapter 5 and 6.  [/p][p][/p][p] I also will have a full guide available as well. Been chipping away at it everyday. I also joined a writing class to help boost my skills in that department and working on learning more animation theory and blender. Building skills and continuing production can be overwhelming at times. Not enough hours in a day. [/p][p]
Hope you're all doing well,

-Meat Shield[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768199/d05779c7330985c9dacf969b54c78329a6554b02.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Book 2 Progress Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Chapter six is in the works. This week I purchased my second render rig finally and will have that up and running!  Will be cool to see how much quicker i can render now that I can render and pose at the same time. 

Book two I'll have a guide for both books as well. One mistake I made in book one was I didn't branch it as much as i should've. I was using an introductory and wanted to give players all the info and backgrounds on characters and story. Book two has a ton more branching. 

I'll have book twos store page for wish lists up by the end of August. Start collecting those wish lists. I hope to release late this year or early next. It will include chapter five and six with the chapter 7 and 8 to release after.

Hope you all are doing well!

Back to the grind! [/p][p][/p][p]-Meat Shield

[/p]

notes.title: Progress Update- Book 2 Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Chapter five is nearly complete. Basically just waiting for everything to render out. I have a second render box to eb assembled that will also help boost productivity, as I will be able to render and work at the same time. Prologue through chapter 2 was 3028 renders. Chapter 5 is 3057 renders in itself. 

I have decided to release book 2 into early access, after the completion of chapter 6. Once released it will be just long as book one with chapter 7 and 8 being even bigger. This is a product of all the pathing.  This will also allow me to be truly fulltime with the project and I can quit my part time job and have my focus 100 percent on the project. I get some really dislike EA games, I get it. I've been burned too. So I completely understand those who will wait till completion to purchase.  

Thank you everyone, it's been surreal to see a lot of people enjoy this project. My story driven AVN is a niche in a niche and the response to it has made me more motivated to deliver. 

Stay Safe, keep fit and eat pizza!
- Meat Shield
